graph.title: LEGO BrickHeadz 41589 Captain America
notes: The PDF steps are small pictures; exact stud-to-stud placement is inferred, so most joined edges leave ports null and name only the two connected pieces.

Step 3 sub-assembly (brown 1x4 plate b14, clip plate b13, brown 1x2 plate b12, four blue 1x1 plates b8-b11) is ambiguous. I assumed b14 sits on the clip plate b13 and on back brick b2, with b12, b8 and b9 on b14, and b10 and b11 stacked on b9 and b8.

The top 4x4 is assumed to be covered by plate b18, corner plates b19 and b20, and door-rail plate b21. The ring of six brackets (b28-b33) and the second ring (b38-b43) are assigned to front, left, right and back positions by inference.
The side and back detail pieces (b53-b66) are attached to the side brackets b30, b31, b40 and b41. The back plate b67 is attached to the back brackets b32, b33, b42 and b43.
The shield b71 clips onto the end-clip plate b27 (arm assembled in step 7). The side clip plate b24 is the other hand with an empty clip.

Legs (blue bricks b74, b75 on black plates b72, b73) are shown on the upside-down body and are assumed to attach to the 2x2 plate b70 on the base b1. The finished figure then stands on the black display base b79, which carries the tile b78, the 1x4 plate b76 and the tile b77.
Part ids b1-b79 follow build order. Colours and types come from the official parts list.
